**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**
-----------------


We are a global energy business involved in every aspect of the energy system. We are working towards delivering light, heat and mobility to millions of people, every day. We are one of the very few companies equipped to solve some of the big complex challenges that matter for the future. We have a real contribution to make to the world's ambition of a low carbon future. Join us and be part of what we can accomplish together. You can participate in our new ambition to become a net zero company by 2050 or sooner, and to help the world get to net zero.


Critical to achieving bp’s digital ambitions is the delivery of our high value data and analytics initiatives, and the enablement of the technologies and platforms that will support those objectives. We are developing deep data capability to transform the access, supply, control and quality to our vast and ever\-growing reserves of data.


We are looking for an outstanding Data Architect with deep expertise in **Microsoft Azure** and **Databricks** to design, build, and optimize modern data platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong architectural leadership, hands\-on technical proficiency, and the ability to influence internal customers to drive data strategy, governance, and scalable data solutions.. These use cases would drive significant operational efficiency, safety and environmental aims that are key to the transformation of bp.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Data Architecture \& Platform Design**


* Architect end\-to\-end **cloud\-native data platforms** using Azure services, including Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, and Event/Service Bus.
* Define and implement **data modeling standards**, including dimensional, canonical, and domain\-driven designs.
* Design **Delta Lake architectures**, including medallion (Bronze–Silver–Gold) frameworks.
* Develop scalable and secure **ETL/ELT pipelines** using Databricks (PySpark/Spark SQL).

**2\. Databricks \& Delta Lake Engineering**
--------------------------------------------


* Implement **Delta Lake best practices**, including OPTIMIZE, ZORDER, Change Data Feed (CDF), schema evolution, and table versioning.
* Optimize Spark workloads for performance, cost, and cluster utilization.
* Lead governance implementation using **Unity Catalog**, including permissions, data lineage, and metadata modeling.

**3\. Azure Data Ecosystem Integration**
----------------------------------------


* Integrate solutions across Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, Event Hubs, Functions, Key Vault, Azure DevOps, and Purview.
* Drive CI/CD and Infrastructure\-as\-Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
* Build APIs and microservices supporting data consumption.

**4\. Data Governance \& Security**
-----------------------------------


* Define policies for **data quality**, **master data management**, **metadata**, and **data lifecycle management**.
* Ensure GDPR\-compliant data design, encryption (KMS/Key Vault), RBAC/ABAC, and secure network architecture.
* Establish frameworks for observability, including logging, monitoring, and alerting.

**5\. Stakeholder Leadership**
------------------------------


* Collaborate with business, product owners, engineers, and analysts to gather data requirements.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide long\-term technology strategy.
* Mentor engineering teams on Azure, Databricks, and scalable data design principles.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
-------------------------------------


**Technical Skills**


* 7\+ years in Data Architecture or Data Engineering roles.
* Expert\-level knowledge of:
* **Azure Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow), Agent Bricks**
* **Azure Data Lake Gen2**
* **Azure Data Factory / Synapse Pipelines**
* **Azure SQL / Synapse Dedicated SQL / Cosmos DB**
* **Unity Catalog \& Delta Live Tables**
* Strong programming experience in **PySpark**, **SQL**, and **Python**.
* Hands\-on with **CI/CD (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions)**.
* Deep understanding of **distributed systems \& big data performance tuning**.

**Soft Skills**
---------------


* Ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture.
* Strong documentation, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Leadership in multi\-disciplinary teams and sophisticated enterprise environments.

**Formal education**
--------------------


* A Bachelor's (or higher) degree, ideally in Computer Science, MIS/IT, Mathematics, chartered accountancy, engineering, or equivalent work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills**
---------------------------------------


* Azure certifications (e.g., **DP\-203**, **AZ\-305**, **Databricks Data Engineer** **Professional/Associate**).
* Courses on Generative AI in Data engineering
* Experience with **data mesh**, **domain\-driven design**, and **event\-driven architecture**.
* Familiarity with Power BI or other BI tools.
* Experience integrating governance tools such as **Azure Purview**.
* TOGAF 9 certification

title: Senior Deployment Engineer
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**The Team**



Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business\-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business\-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI\-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go\-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long\-term success of our customers.


**The Role**



As a Senior Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands\-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI\-augmented workflows to deliver high\-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis's AI deployment tools as your primary instruments \- directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.



This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI\-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. **You generate value by understanding the customer's business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.**

  

**The Work You'll Do**


**Initiate and Connect**


* Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers' strategic objectives into high\-impact Celonis use cases
* Collaborate with the customer's IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
* Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required


**Build \& Value**


* Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards \- writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
* Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI\-powered insights
* Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
* Validate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context \- applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
* Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
* Define and build KPIs measuring the customer's success and quantify business impact
* Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance


 **Rollout, Adoption, and Handover**


* Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long\-term adoption
* Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
* Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
* Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff


**Domain \& Industry Depth**


* Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
* Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
* Proactively identify and standardize high\-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap


**What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era**


* You work with AI agents as your primary tools \- your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
* You need strong specification and context engineering skills \- the ability to translate a customer's ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
* You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
* You balance speed with quality \- AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
* You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable


**The Qualifications You Need**


* **Experience:** 4\+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. For Senior DE: 6\+ years with demonstrated project leadership.
* **Platform skills:** Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
* **AI fluency:** Comfort working with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI\-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
* **Business and process domain expertise :** Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
* **Consulting skills:** Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.
* **Analytical mindset:** Excellent problem\-solving skills with a value\-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
* **Learning agility:** Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
* **Languages:** Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.
* **Travel**: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

**What Celonis can offer you:**


* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI\-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full\-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit\-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work\-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70\-20\-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well\-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion \& Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value\-Driven Impact: Join a mission\-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.


**About Us:**



Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Job Title:  

* ASIC Verification\- Senior Staff Engineer

  

We Are:  

  

 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.  

  

You Are:  

  

 You are an accomplished verification engineer with a passion for excellence and a track record of delivering robust, high\-quality IP solutions. You thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and are excited by the opportunity to work on next\-generation connectivity protocols that power commercial, enterprise, and automotive applications. With a solid foundation in Electrical/Electronics Engineering (BSEE with 8\+ years or MSEE with 6\+ years of relevant experience), you bring deep expertise in System Verilog and industry\-standard verification methodologies such as UVM/OVM/VMM. Your hands\-on experience developing HVL\-based test environments and extracting meaningful verification metrics sets you apart as a technical leader.  

  

 You are a collaborative team player who values knowledge sharing and actively contributes to a culture of continuous improvement. Your familiarity with protocols like MIPI\-I3C, UFS, AMBA, Ethernet, DDR, PCIe, and USB allows you to quickly ramp up on new projects and deliver results. You bring a strong analytical mindset, exceptional debugging skills, and a drive to meet and exceed quality metrics. Experienced with scripting languages like Perl, TCL, and Python, you automate processes for efficiency and scalability. Your strong communication skills, initiative, and global perspective enable you to work effectively with cross\-functional and multi\-site teams. Above all, you are a lifelong learner who embraces challenges, adapts to new technologies, and is committed to shaping the future of silicon design.  

  

What You’ll Be Doing:  

* Specify, architect, and implement advanced verification environments for DesignWare IP cores using System Verilog and state\-of\-the\-art methodologies.
* Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, ensuring coverage of unit\-level and system\-level requirements.
* Design, code, and debug testbenches, test cases, and functional coverage models to validate complex IP functionalities.
* Perform functional coverage analysis and manage regression testing to achieve and maintain required quality metrics.
* Collaborate closely with RTL designers and global verification teams to resolve issues and drive verification closure.
* Leverage scripting (Perl, TCL, Python) to automate verification flows, streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of verification methodologies, including VIP development and formal verification approaches.

  

The Impact You Will Have:  

* Ensure the delivery of high\-quality, robust IP cores that power critical applications in commercial, enterprise, and automotive markets.
* Drive innovation in verification methodologies, setting new standards for efficiency and coverage.
* Enhance time\-to\-market by identifying and resolving design and verification issues early in the development cycle.
* Strengthen Synopsys’ reputation as a leader in silicon IP and verification through technical excellence and customer focus.
* Mentor and support junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to the success of global, multi\-site R\&D teams by providing expertise and driving cross\-functional collaboration.

  

What You’ll Need:  

* BSEE with 8 years or MSEE with 6\+ years of relevant experience in ASIC or IP verification.
* Expertise in developing HVL (System Verilog)\-based verification environments and testbenches.
* Strong hands\-on experience with industry\-standard simulators (VCS, NC, MTI) and debugging tools.
* Proficiency in verification methodologies such as UVM, OVM, or VMM; exposure to formal verification is highly desirable.
* Solid understanding of protocols such as MIPI\-I3C/UFS/Unipro, AMBA, SD/eMMC, Ethernet, DDR, PCIe, USB.
* Familiarity with scripting languages (Perl, TCL, Python) and HDLs (Verilog); experience with VIP development is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to work with functional coverage\-driven methodologies and quality metric goals.

  

Who You Are:  

* Analytical thinker with strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Team player who thrives in collaborative, multi\-site environments.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and able to take initiative on challenging projects.
* Detail\-oriented, quality\-focused, and driven by a desire to excel.
* Adaptable and eager to continuously learn and new technologies.

  

The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:  

  

 You will join the Solutions Group’s DesignWare IP Verification R\&D team, a highly skilled and diverse group of engineers dedicated to delivering world\-class IP cores for next\-generation connectivity. The team operates in a collaborative, multi\-site environment, leveraging global expertise to solve complex verification challenges. Together, you will drive innovation,
